newsitem.title: USA: Conn. plans to sell $100 mln variable rate GOs.
newsitem.headline: Conn. plans to sell $100 mln variable rate GOs.

text.p: Connecticut on Monday said it planned to sell about $100 million of variable-rate, general obligation bonds on Wednesday through a syndicate that will be led by Goldman Sachs.
Pat O'Neill, a spokesman for the state treasurer, added that the state awarded a standby purchase agreement to a German bank, Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale

He added that while 12 foreign banks--French, Canadian, Belgium and German institutions--competed for the business, no U.S. banks appeared interested. "There were no U.S. banks that came forward," he said.
